Hi Emilia —

Congrats — our system flagged a sustained usage spike from your account this morning (tokens and embeddings). That’s usually a great signal that teams are moving from experimentation to building. I’m Soojin on the SDR team at Redwood — wanted to offer a quick 20-minute walkthrough to show a couple of things that typically help teams like NeonMaps:

- Low-latency embedding pipelines (how we keep 99th pct latency predictable)
- Batching & cache tips to cut token costs by ~30% for map-generation workloads
- Quick safety checklist and what to expect in a Dedicated trial

No heavy sales pitch — just a short, technical-first session. Here are a few 20-min windows I have this week (PST):
- Thu 12/07 09:00–09:20
- Thu 12/07 13:30–13:50
- Fri 12/08 10:00–10:20

If none work, share a couple times that do and I’ll sync a calendar invite. I’ve attached a one-pager and a short onboarding runbook we often share with teams running map-embedding pipelines.

Thanks —
Soojin Lee
